term: causing a whole to exist causes its parts to exist
definition: `CausingWholeCausesParts o F w := ∀ c y, o.Causes w c F.whole → PartOfSpacetime F y → o.Causes w c y`: whatever causes the spacetime whole to exist causes each of its parts to exist.
note: Owner's bridge (#1109), analyst formulation, open. Its rival is the Hume–Edwards view that the whole needs no cause over and above its parts, and the causal-loop model CAUSAL-LOOP-REJECTS-BRIDGE shows it is exactly what a loop escape must deny.
